title: A Day at the Hockey Game
content:
Tom loves sports, but he has never watched a hockey game.

One Saturday, his friend Mike invites him to a game.

— Come with me! I can explain how hockey works, Mike says.

At the arena, Tom sees two teams on the ice.

— Why are they wearing special shoes? Tom asks.

— Those are ice skates, Mike explains. Players use them to move quickly on the ice.

The game begins.

The players have hockey sticks and try to hit a small black puck.

— The goal is simple, Mike says. Each team tries to put the puck into the other team's goal.

Tom watches carefully.

— So, the team with more goals wins?

— Exactly!

Each team has six players on the ice, including a goalkeeper.

The players pass the puck, skate quickly, and work together as a team.

Suddenly, one player hits the puck into the goal.

— Goal! everyone shouts.

Tom stands up and cheers.

— Now I understand! he says.

After the game, Tom smiles.

— Hockey is fast and exciting. You need to skate, pass the puck, and score goals.

Mike laughs.

— And next time, you can play with us!

Tom looks at the ice.

— Maybe first, I need to learn how to skate!
